title: lippia hirsuta var. moritzii
intro: Lippia hirsuta var. moritzii, commonly known as Mexican lime, is a plant species that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lippia hirsuta var. moritzii include antispasmodic, antiulcer, and antiseptic effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
